svg.text: A. The deep block: front, back and above
Larch Street built backwards and upwards: three stacked routes along one block, cross-linked every 20-25 m. Walt's shop at the bottom (west), the hill house at the top (east).
Garages of Birch Lane (boundary): brick backs 3.2 m, runnable
THE LANE 5 m wide, tarmac, falls 2 m toward Walt's end: a slide lane
